scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.format: prettier --write client/src server/src server/test api package.json vercel.json .prettierrc.json README.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check client/src server/src server/test api package.json vercel.json .prettierrc.json README.md
